topic: Profit aur cash flow alag cheezein hain
caption:
Customer ka ₹3,000 tiffin bill ban gaya, par payment 15 din baad aayegi. Ingredients aur delivery ka paisa aaj dena hai. Sale hui—cash abhi nahi. 👇

Profit ka hisaab ek period ki income aur expenses dekhta hai; cash flow batata hai paisa kab aaya aur kab gaya. Isliye payment due dates aur upcoming kharche saath track karo.

Aap customer payments kitne din mein receive karte ho?

#BusinessJalwa #CashFlow #SmallBusiness #BusinessBasics #Hinglish

scenes.narration: Aapne customer ko teen hazaar rupaye ke tiffin deliver kiye, lekin payment pandrah din baad milegi. Sale hui, par cash abhi account mein nahi aaya.
scenes.question: ₹3,000 ki sale

scenes.narration: Profit ka hisaab batata hai ek period mein income aur kharche ke baad kya bacha. Cash flow batata hai paisa kab andar aaya aur kab bahar gaya.
scenes.question: Profit vs cash flow

scenes.narration: Ingredients aur delivery ka paisa aaj dena hai, customer transfer baad mein karega. Is gap mein account ka balance kam ho sakta hai, chahe order par contribution bachta ho.
scenes.question: Kharche pehle

scenes.narration: Har invoice ka amount, payment due date aur supplier bill ki date likho. Sirf total sales dekhne se cash ki timing nahi samajh aati.
scenes.question: Kya track karein?

scenes.narration: Weekly cash sheet banao, payment reminder bhejo, aur zarurat ho to clear advance terms rakho. Isse agle kharche ka cash pehle plan kar sakte ho.
